author: (F.S.Collins) M.A.Howe, 1928

note.en: A small, fine-branched red tuft known here from one herbarium specimen from the outer reef of Portete Bay.
note.es: Un mechón rojo pequeño de ramas finas que se conoce aquí por un solo ejemplar de herbario del arrecife exterior de la bahía de Portete.

evidence: GBIF herbarium specimen: outer reef of Portete Bay, Limón (Dawson and Rudersdorf)

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: GBIF herbarium specimen: outer reef of Portete Bay, Limón (Dawson and Rudersdorf).
